errors.slugReserved: That address is used by an Oxagen page. Pick another.
errors.workspaceNameRequired: Enter a name for the first workspace.

errors.agentNameRequired: Enter a name for the agent.

organization.title: Name your organization
organization.lead: The organization is the tenant: it owns its own graph database, its own encryption key, its billing account, and the namespace that appears in every agent key.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.addressHint: Derived from the name. You can change it later.
organization.namespaceHint: 2–6 characters, immutable. Every agent key starts with it: {namespace}.'<'workspace'>'.'<'agent'>'
organization.governanceNotBacked: The governance mode is not recorded yet. The workspace has no column for it, so the choice is not saved.
organization.workspaceHint: A workspace is a governance partition: one main repo, one steering set, its own agents, tool grants and budgets.
organization.namespaceTaken: That namespace is taken. {namespace} belongs to another organization. Pick a different 2–6 character namespace.

shell.caption: The operator console does not open until an agent has talked to Oxagen. That first frame is also the installer’s smoke test, so there is one path, not two.

denied.title: You cannot see onboarding
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.bodyNoOrg: Your account does not hold {permission}. An organization owner can grant it; the grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.decidedByValue: the organization role check · deny wins over every allow
denied.dialogBody: A request would ask an organization owner to grant {permission}, and the grant would land in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.dialogNotBacked: Access requests are not recorded yet: no capability lets a person ask for a role, so nothing is sent. Ask an organization owner directly.

wrap.title: Wrap an agent
wrap.lead: The installer carries a one-time enrollment token for <k>{key}</k>, so nothing is copied or pasted.
wrap.leadNoKey: The installer carries a one-time enrollment token for the agent, so nothing is copied or pasted.
wrap.ccBody: The installer writes the hooks, installs the <mono>oxagend</mono> collector and the <mono>oxagen-hook</mono> binary, registers them to start at login, and enrolls this host with an Ed25519 device key. Nothing is copied or pasted: the one-time enrollment token is embedded in the download.
wrap.ccTier: The tier is computed per run from what was actually routed, never from what the adapter can do on paper. Hooks deliver steering and can refuse at four events, client-attested and fail-open. No report can render a stronger word than the tier allows.
wrap.codexBody: The same installer, with the Codex profile. It writes <mono>~/.codex/config.toml</mono>: the Oxagen MCP server, the notify hook to the collector, and the approval policy routed through Oxagen.
wrap.codexTier: Which of the two the native tools earn depends on the harness version. On versions that do not expose an approval hook the agent is recorded only, and the run says so.
wrap.sdkBody: Five lines in your own process. <mono>oxagen.agent.wrap({})</mono> installs a frame emitter, the checkpoint gate before each turn, and the Oxagen MCP endpoint as the agent’s tool server. Works with the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Claude Agent SDK, Stella, and any custom loop.
wrap.downloadNotBacked: No signed installer is published for {os} yet, so there is nothing to download. Run the command below instead; it enrolls this host the same way.
wrap.packageNotBacked: Package name, size and checksum are not recorded: no signed package is published.
wrap.credentialNone: No live credential is recorded for this agent.
wrap.credentialBody: Set it as <mono>OXAGEN_AGENT_TOKEN</mono>. Oxagen mints short-lived run tokens from it at run start. Revoking the credential kills every run token at the next call.
wrap.copyFailed: The browser refused the clipboard. Select the lines and copy them by hand.
wrap.caption: Nothing completes until a frame arrives.
wrap.continue: I have already installed it — continue
wrap.noAgentBody: The gate does not name a first agent, and this workspace has no Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Stella agent registered. An enrollment token is minted for a registered agent, so register one first.

run.title: Start a run
run.lead: The operator console opens the moment the first frame from <k>{key}</k> reaches Oxagen, and lands you on Fleet looking at your own run.
run.leadNoKey: The operator console opens the moment the agent’s first frame reaches Oxagen, and lands you on Fleet looking at your own run.

log.hooksOk: hooks written · the collector checked them
log.hooksMissing: hooks missing · the collector found none
log.notBacked: The collector’s install steps are not recorded one by one yet; the lines above are the ones Oxagen holds.

run.start: Start {harness} in any repository on the enrolled host. The installer already ran a one-turn smoke session; if it is still in flight this flips on its own.
run.startNoHost: Run the installer or the enroll command from the wrap step on the machine the agent runs on. Nothing has enrolled for this agent yet.
run.framesNotRecorded: The run’s frames are not readable yet.
run.tierBody: The tier is computed from what was actually routed, not from what the adapter can do on paper. This run recorded {tier}.
run.tierBodyHarness: The tier is computed from what was actually routed, not from what the adapter can do on paper. The hooks answered, so this run is harness: delivered, recorded, client-attested, fail-open.
run.noDone: There is no Done button — the frame is the completion.
run.errorBody: The host enrolled at {at}, but no heartbeat from its collector has reached Oxagen for {seconds} seconds. No frame has arrived, so the operator console stays closed.
run.errorFix: Check that outbound 443 to <mono>api.oxagen.sh</mono> is allowed on the host, then start the agent again.
run.checkedAgain: Checked again. Still no heartbeat from the host.

repo.remoteBody: Read from the git remote of the directory the installer ran in.
repo.bindBody: Binding uses the workspace’s GitHub App installation on <mono>{repository}</mono>: repo binding, Context PRs, checks, merge handling and the code graph.
repo.skipBody: — {workspace} stays provisional for {days} days. Runs record and spend counts, but steering, context records and agent definitions stay off until a main repo is bound.
repo.boundBody: Steering, context records and agent definitions will live in <mono>{repository}</mono> under <mono>.oxagen/</mono>, published through Context PRs.
repo.boundToast: GitHub App installed on {repository}. Main repo bound — Context PRs, checks and the code graph are on.
repo.skippedBody: {workspace} is provisional until {until} ({days} days). Runs record and spend counts. Steering, context records, and agent definitions stay off until a main repo is bound.
repo.noneBody: The enrolling host reported no GitHub remote. {workspace} is provisional until {until}. Bind a main repo from Repositories when one exists.

installer.title: Oxagen Agent Installer
installer.downloadBody: One signed package installs the collector, the hook binary and a login item, then enrolls this host to {org} / {workspace}. The one-time enrollment token is embedded, so there is nothing to paste.
installer.tokenOnWrap: embedded at download; shown once on the wrap step
installer.userOnly: Installs to your user account only. No sudo, no kernel extension, and nothing leaves the host except frames.

steps.policy: Fetch the signed policy bundle and cache it
steps.mcp: Register the Oxagen MCP endpoint as a tool server
steps.enroll: Enroll this host with an Ed25519 device key

installer.connectedBody: The smoke session produced its first frame and Oxagen countersigned it. <k>{key}</k> is wrapped.
installer.connectedBodyNoKey: The smoke session produced its first frame and Oxagen countersigned it.
installer.notConnectedBody: No frame from this workspace has reached Oxagen yet. This screen reads the record, so it shows Connected only once the first frame lands.
installer.rollback: Roll back at any time. This removes the hooks, the login item and the base URL, and restores your previous settings file:
installer.unlocking: The operator console is already unlocking in your browser.
installer.rejectedBody: The token <mono>{token}</mono> has already been used, at {at} by host <mono>{host}</mono>. Enrollment tokens are single use.
installer.rejectedNext: Nothing was installed. Generate a fresh token from the wrap step and run the installer again.

gate.title: Finish setting up this workspace
gate.lead: Oxagen opens when an agent you wrapped has talked to it. That first frame is also the installer's smoke test, so one path covers both.

subs.organization: Tenant, namespace and the first workspace
subs.wrap: Claude Code, an SDK agent or your own loop
subs.run: The first frame is what opens Oxagen

provisional.title: {workspace} is provisional until {until}
provisional.body: Runs record and spend counts. Steering, context records and agent definitions stay off until a main repo is bound, because there is nowhere to publish them to.
provisional.noRepository: No enrolled host has reported a GitHub remote for this workspace. Bind its main repository from Workspace settings, or from the register flow once a host has reported one.

firstRun.title: The first frame arrived
firstRun.body: This workspace recorded <run></run> when the gate opened. The tiles below read off the runs it has kept since.

register.caption: Registration completes when the agent has talked to Oxagen. That first frame is also the installer's smoke test, so one path covers both.

noAgent.title: No agent to wrap yet
noAgent.body: This step works on the identity the first step mints. Start from Name the agent.

name.title: Name the agent
name.lead: The slug is reserved now and is immutable. The agent itself exists once its first frame reaches Oxagen.
name.slugHint: The last segment of the agent key becomes {slug}.
name.agentNameHint: What the fleet lists this identity as.
name.harnessHint: Decides how the agent is wrapped on the next step. It is recorded on the identity and does not change afterwards.
name.descriptionHint: Optional. What this agent is for.
name.note: Continuing mints the identity, its delegated principal and one long-lived credential shown once. The definition file is committed separately, and the first frame is what puts the agent on Fleet.

registered.title: {name} is registered
registered.body: This credential is shown once and is never recoverable. Set it as OXAGEN_AGENT_TOKEN wherever the agent runs.

wrap.title: Wrap the agent
wrap.lead: A wrapped agent routes through at least one gateway seam: the model proxy, the tool gateway, or both. The enforcement tier is computed per run from what was actually routed.

host.title: Enrol this machine
host.body: The token below is what a machine presents to become this agent's host. Presenting it mints the host's scoped key, the signed enrollment the collector verifies offline, and the initial policy bundle.

token.label: One-time enrollment token
token.once: Shown once, single use, and consumed the first time it is presented.
token.command: Run this on the machine the agent works from:

unavailable.title: Wrapping is not available for this harness
unavailable.body: This agent identity is registered, but its harness has no supported wrapping adapter here. Choose Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Stella to enrol a host and record its first run.

run.title: Wait for the first frame
run.lead: The agent appears on Fleet when its first frame reaches Oxagen. Nothing here completes on a timer.

waiting.title: Waiting for the first frame
waiting.body: Start the agent on the machine that enrolled. This page waits on the record itself, one call at a time, and re-reads while a host is enrolled.

host.none: No host has enrolled for this agent. The token from the previous step is what enrols one.
host.noHeartbeat: The collector has not reported yet.
host.hooksMissing: The collector reports the harness hooks are missing. Calls it does not route are recorded, not governed.
host.hooksUnreported: The collector has not reported the hooks yet.

received.title: First frame received
received.body: <run></run> is recorded and the agent is on Fleet. Its enforcement tier is computed from what was actually routed.

repository.title: Repository detected
repository.body: Read from the git remote of the directory the installer ran in. Binding it as the main repo needs the Oxagen GitHub App installed on its owner, which Workspace settings walks you through. The binding is what turns on Context PRs, checks, merge handling and the code graph.
repository.skip: Skipping leaves {workspace} provisional until {until}. Runs record and spend counts, and steering, context records and agent definitions stay off until a main repo is bound.

failure.orgRoleRequired: This account may not register agents here. An organization owner or admin can.
failure.noPrincipal: The call carried no person Oxagen could check a role for. Nothing ran.
failure.agentNotFound: That agent is not in this workspace. Nothing was written.
failure.slugTaken: An agent in this workspace already holds that slug. Pick another.
failure.gateNotFound: This workspace is not the organization's onboarding workspace, so it has no gate to move.
failure.alreadyUnlocked: The gate is already open. Oxagen is unlocked.
failure.firstFrameRequired: The run step completes when the first frame arrives. It cannot be skipped.
failure.githubNotConnected: No GitHub App installation reaches this workspace. Connect GitHub, then bind the repository.
failure.repositoryNotInstalled: This workspace's GitHub App installation cannot see that repository.
failure.mainRepoBound: This workspace already binds a different main repository.
failure.refused: The write was refused: {code}. Nothing was changed.
failure.invalid: The form was refused before the write ran. Check the fields above.
failure.pendingApproval: The write is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.unavailable: The write did not complete: {code}. Nothing was changed.
